title: script.execute
description: Run a script on a host or event. Except for URL type scripts, which are not executable.

scriptid.description: ID of the script to run. Required.

hostid.description: ID of the host to run the script on. Required if eventid is not set.

eventid.description: ID of the event to run the script on. Required if hostid is not set.

manualinput.description: User-provided value to run the script with, substituting the {MANUALINPUT} macro.
